description: 车消除保护f8的马，后续组合攻杀
explanation_en: A rook removes the knight guarding the bishop on f8, allowing a follow-up attack.

intro.popup: 💡 消除保护：黑马Ne6保护着黑象Bf8。白方如何消除这个保护，打开攻势？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Removing the defender: Black's knight on e6 protects the bishop on f8. How can White remove the defender and open the attack?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxe6消除保护f8的马！Qxf8后车Rxg7+剥开国王，联合绝杀。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxe6 removes the knight guarding f8. After Qxf8 and ...Rxf8, Rxg7+ exposes the king and starts a coordinated attack.

moves.popup: 车消除防守马！Ne6是保护Bf8的关键子，拿掉它！
moves.popup_en: The rook removes the defender! The knight on e6 is the key piece protecting Bf8; eliminate it.
Black's queen captures the rook, but the knight is gone.

moves.popup: 白后吃象！马已不在，f8失去保护！
moves.popup_en: White's queen captures the bishop! With the knight removed, f8 is no longer protected.

moves.popup: 黑车吃后，但白方还有绝招！
moves.popup_en: Black's rook captures the queen, but White has another tactical shot!
Rxg7+! The rook tears open the king's defenses with check.
